item.title: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青)
item.description: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) is 主席 of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西南區代表; ntpc-usa.org).

item.title: Rev. Ching Fang Chen (陳清芳)
item.description: Rev. Ching Fang Chen (陳清芳) Rev. Ching Fang Chen (陳清芳) is a Taiwanese American pastor and the inaugural Chair of the NTPC Historical Committee (2025).

item.title: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹)
item.description: Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) Rev. Pinghsi Liu (劉炳熹) is a PCT pastor. From 14 September 2020 he was 第十任 pastor of 台南東門巴克禮紀念教會.

item.title: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔)
item.description: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔) Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔, Lai Ping-tung) was a Taiwanese Presbyterian pastor, Bible Society pioneer, and evangelist.

item.title: Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然)
item.description: Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然) Tyzen Hsiao (蕭泰然, POJ: Siau Thài-jiân, 1 January 1938 – 24 February 2015) was a Taiwanese neo-Romantic composer, pianist, and conductor.

item.title: Apo Hsu (許瀞心)
item.description: Apo Hsu (許瀞心) Apo Hsu (許瀞心; also Apo Ching-Hsin Hsu on English concert listings) is a Taiwan-born conductor and teacher.
